orange.$description: Substack orange: the 'Turn on' button, 'Subscribe back', the unread dots, the light compose button and the badge on Chat. The same value in both themes (light reads #FF5804).

blue.$description: The system blue Substack keeps for controls: switches, the selected option rim, checklist ticks. The same value in both themes (light reads #0578FF).

red.$description: Destructive red: Report, Mute, Block, Disable all, and a liked heart.

publicationBlue.$description: The System Design Newsletter's own colour on its Subscribe buttons. Each publication brings its own; this is the only one read.

000.$description: Used by: light bg.page (Sampled), light surface.card (Sampled), light surface.sheet (Sampled).

250.$description: Used by: light bg.grouped (Sampled), light surface.secondary (Sampled).

800.$description: Used by: dark control.progressFill (Sampled), light control.progressFill (Sampled).

1250.$description: Used by: dark bg.grouped (Sampled), dark surface.secondary (Sampled), dark surface.tile (Sampled).

1300.$description: Used by: dark surface.raised (Sampled), dark surface.sheet (Sampled).

1350.$description: Used by: dark bg.page (Sampled), dark surface.card (Sampled).

card.$description: Grouped cards in Settings, the banner and the 'Find people' card. Diagonal-inset readings: Settings card 11.9pt, empty-state card 8.5pt, 'Find people' card 10.2pt. Plus or minus 2 pt.

button.$description: Full-size buttons: 'Share' 11.9pt, 'Turn on' 11.9pt. Plus or minus 2 pt.

publicationButton.$description: The publication's Subscribe button inside a post: 10.2pt.

small.$description: Small buttons and checkboxes: 'Subscribe back' 6.8pt, checkbox 6.8pt.

option.$description: Option buttons in Display Settings, read along the diagonal of the selected button's outer rim: 8.5pt.

capsule.$description: Fully round ends: the tab bar and its selected pill, the top tabs' selected pill, chips, the switch, the search fields, the nav bar's Subscribe pill, glass nav buttons and the compose button (a circle).

base.$description: Measured gaps land on multiples of 4 pt within a pixel or two.

xs.$description: Between an icon and its count under a note.

sm.$description: Between the title and the meta line of an inbox row, and between stacked buttons.

md.$description: Inside chips and option buttons, and between a row icon tile and its label.

lg.$description: Screen margin: grouped cards start 16 pt from the screen edge, and grouped cards sit 16 pt apart (rows.settings: 947 to 979 px).

xl.$description: Between feed items and above a section title.

screenMargin.$description: Left and right margin of cards, rows, notes and post text (notes start at 16 to 17 pt, post text at 20 pt).

row.$description: Grouped settings row, divider to divider.

height.$description: Floating glass tab bar, rim included.

width.$description: Floating tab bar width (345.5pt): 22 pt in from each screen edge.

item.$description: Height of the selected item's pill inside the bar (82.5x54pt dark, 92.5x53.5pt light; glass edges make the width vary).

navButton.$description: Round glass back, close and more buttons (45pt dark, rim included).

button.$description: Paired full-width buttons on the profile (Share, Edit): 174x35pt.

buttonBanner.$description: Buttons inside the banner (Later, Turn on): 136x37pt.

buttonPublication.$description: The publication's Subscribe button inside a post: 116x43.5pt.

buttonSmall.$description: Small inline buttons on activity rows (Subscribe back, Message): 112.5x31pt.

navPill.$description: The Subscribe pill in the reader's nav bar: 100x38pt.

tab.$description: Selected pill behind a top tab ('For you' is 67.5pt wide).

option.$description: Option buttons in Display Settings, fill inside the rim: 111x49pt.

avatarStory.$description: Publication avatar in the top row of Home (a rounded square of the publication's artwork).

thumbnail.$description: Post thumbnail at the end of an inbox row: 56.5pt by 57pt.

progress.$description: Reading-progress bar width (54x8pt at tolerance 20; the solid core is about 2.5 pt tall).

touchTarget.$description: Rows, nav buttons, the tab bar items and the search field are 44 pt or more. Small buttons (31 pt), chips (35 pt), top tabs (26 pt) and checkboxes (23 pt) are smaller and sit inside taller rows.

hairline.$description: Dividers between rows and the rim of raised rows: one device pixel at 2x, anti-aliased over two or three capture pixels.

option.$description: Rim of an unselected option button: two capture pixels.

optionSelected.$description: Rim of the selected option button: four capture pixels.

base.$description: Not determinable from pixels. A neo-grotesque sans for the whole interface, heavier in titles; use the platform font.

reader.$description: The serif for post bodies. The app names it: Display Settings > Article font lists New York (selected), Messina and Tiempos. The style guide falls back to the platform serif.

regular.$description: Note and post text, subtitles, meta lines. Judged by stroke width, not measured.

medium.$description: Top tabs, chips and tab bar labels. Judged by stroke width.

semibold.$description: Row titles, settings rows, nav and sheet titles, button labels, names on notes. Judged by stroke width.

bold.$description: Tab screen titles, section titles and the Settings title. Judged by stroke width.

heavy.$description: Post titles in the reader. Judged by stroke width.

largeTitle.$description: The Settings sheet title. Cap-height readings: 28pt.

screenTitle.$description: Tab screen titles (Read, Podcasts, Chat, Activity). Cap-height readings: 24pt.

postTitle.$description: A post's title in the reader. Cap-height readings: 27pt.

sectionTitle.$description: Section titles (Your inbox, Next up, Your shows). Cap-height readings: 20pt.

reader.$description: Post body text, in the reader serif. Cap-height readings: 17pt.

postSubtitle.$description: A post's subtitle under its title. Cap-height readings: 17pt.

headline.$description: Inbox and search row titles, settings rows, nav and sheet titles, button labels, menu items, the banner title, the Listen pill. Cap-height readings: 15pt, 16pt.

body.$description: Note text in the feed and the profile bio. Cap-height readings: 15pt.

link.$description: Link buttons in a grouped card (Restore in-app purchases) and empty-state titles. Cap-height readings: 14pt.

subheadline.$description: Top tabs and topic chips. Cap-height readings: 12pt, 13pt.

footnote.$description: Publication names, read times, dates, bylines, search result subtitles, the banner subtitle, helper text under cards. Cap-height readings: 12pt.

kicker.$description: Upper-case publication name above a post title and the byline names (text case is not a DTCG property). Cap-height readings: 12pt.

caption.$description: Tab bar labels, upper-case grouped section headers and settings row subtitles. Cap-height readings: 10pt.

notTokenised: iOS 26 glass (the tab bar, nav buttons, the selected top tab, the nav bar's Subscribe pill): blur and refraction come from the system material
Continuous (squircle) corners: DTCG has no value for corner smoothing
Shadows: only the light banner shows a soft one, too faint to read as a value
Text case: section headers, the kicker and the byline are upper case
Per-publication colour: each publication's Subscribe buttons take its own colour; color.publicationBlue is one example

page.$description: Tab screens (Home, Read, Search, Podcasts, Chat, Activity) and the post reader.

grouped.$description: The Settings sheet and its pushed pages, behind grouped cards.

scrim.$description: Black at 20%: the post reader reads #FFFFFF undimmed and #CCCCCC under the Options sheet.

card.$description: Grouped cards on the Settings sheet and its pages: the page colour, set on bg.grouped.

sheet.$description: Options and Display Settings sheets, and the notifications pre-prompt.

raised.$description: Full-width raised rows on a page ('View saved notes', 'Find people you know').

banner.$description: The 'Notifications are off' banner card in Chat.

tile.$description: Small tiles and pills on a page: Creator stats, the Listen pill, the '1 recommendation' chip, unselected chips.

iconTile.$description: Rounded tile behind each settings row icon.

glass.$description: Glass controls over a flat page (search fields); the tab bar and nav buttons use the same material.

tabBar.$description: Floating tab bar, centre reading. The box's dominant colour covers 78% of it (a gradient, glass or a thin mark), so it is a reading, not an exact fill.

tabBarSelected.$description: Pill behind the selected tab bar item: darker than the bar in dark, a grey in light. The box's dominant colour covers 64% of it (a gradient, glass or a thin mark), so it is a reading, not an exact fill.

tabSelected.$description: Glass pill behind the selected top tab ('For you', 'Saved', 'All'). The box's dominant colour covers 29% of it (a gradient, glass or a thin mark), so it is a reading, not an exact fill.

optionSelected.$description: Fill of the selected option button: a faint blue tint.

highlight.$description: Highlight behind the matched word in search results. The box's dominant colour covers 47% of it (a gradient, glass or a thin mark), so it is a reading, not an exact fill.

tintOrange.$description: Orange-tinted fill behind orange content: the 'Enable notifications' button on the pre-prompt. Not captured in light: filled from the orange-tinted circle behind a subscribe activity's + icon, the same role.

tintOrangeIcon.$description: Circle behind the orange + on a subscribe activity row. The box's dominant colour covers 86% of it (a gradient, glass or a thin mark), so it is a reading, not an exact fill.

tintPurpleIcon.$description: Circle behind the purple sparkle on a first-note activity row. The box's dominant colour covers 75% of it (a gradient, glass or a thin mark), so it is a reading, not an exact fill.

divider.$description: Hairline between feed and inbox rows.

grouped.$description: Hairline between rows in a grouped card, inset to the row text.

sheet.$description: Hairline under a sheet header and between groups of sheet items.

raised.$description: Rim of a raised row or card on a page.

option.$description: Rim of an unselected option button (Messina, Tiempos).

outline.$description: Rim of an outlined button ('Message'): barely visible.

primary.$description: Titles, row titles, note text, settings labels. Not black: a dark grey.

secondary.$description: Post subtitles, the kicker, byline dates, the profile handle, note action icons. Readings in this role range #868686, #878787.

tertiary.$description: Publication names and meta lines on rows, dates, section headers, unselected tabs, row subtitles, the account email. Readings range #767676, #767777, #777777, #787878, #7A797A, #7A7A7A.

quaternary.$description: The current value beside a Display Settings header ('NEW YORK').

placeholder.$description: Search field placeholders (the Search screen reads #949494).

footnote.$description: Helper text under a grouped card.

onPublication.$description: Labels on the publication-coloured Subscribe button.

link.$description: Link buttons ('Restore in-app purchases'); inline links read #008BFD.

highlight.$description: Matched word in search results, on surface.highlight.

selected.$description: Label of the selected option button.

danger.$description: Destructive items (Report, Mute, Block) and buttons ('Disable all' reads #FF474F): red text, never a red fill.

brand.$description: Orange 'Subscribe' link on a note header.

tabBarSelected.$description: The selected tab bar item's label, on its pill.

brand.$description: Primary actions: 'Turn on', 'Subscribe back'. Substack orange.

brandShare.$description: 'Share' on the owner's profile: a lighter orange than the primary.

dot.$description: Unread dots on publication avatars, inbox rows and chats; the badge on the Chat tab.

control.$description: Switches, checklist ticks and the selected option: the system blue, never orange.

publication.$description: A publication's own colour, on its Subscribe buttons in a post. Varies by publication.

publicationGlass.$description: The same colour as a glass pill in the reader's nav bar. The box's dominant colour covers 81% of it (a gradient, glass or a thin mark), so it is a reading, not an exact fill.

caret.$description: Text caret in a focused search field: the primary text colour, not a tint. The only focus indicator captured.

check.$description: Tick on the chosen row of a checklist (Theme, Default tab).
